generic_domain.support: finite non-negative tensor with positive available mass
generic_domain.base_axes: one or more caller-declared axes for transferability; conditional-information core also permits an empty base set
generic_domain.axis_semantics: arbitrary declared discrete ecological state semantics

analytic_proof_obligations.statement: H(A|B), exp(H(A|B)), I(A;B), and conditional-vs-marginal held-out gain are invariant to independent positive scaling of model and held-out support mass.
Simultaneously permuting tensor axes and remapping declared axis IDs leaves all generic evidence quantities unchanged.
Arbitrary bijective relabelling of categorical states leaves all generic evidence quantities unchanged.
Adding an undeclared refinement/nuisance axis whose submasses marginalize back to the original support leaves base-added evidence unchanged.
For evaluation under the same generating distribution, E[log P(A|B)-log P(A)] equals I(A;B).
If A1 is conditionally independent of A2 given B, H(A1,A2|B)=H(A1|B)+H(A2|B) and effective states multiply.
Grouped terminal classification is determined by per-group gains rather than pooled group mass.
For K joint discrete added states, 1 <= exp(H(A|B)) <= K.

european_free_tailed_bat.added_axis_semantics: native height above mean sea level

snapshot_serengeti.observation_architecture: camera detections with explicit effort intervals

empirical_portability.allowed_claim: The inferential hierarchy is portable across heterogeneous observation architectures, added-axis semantics and replication units.
empirical_portability.forbidden_claim: The three empirical lanes estimate a universal frequency or mechanism of multidimensional niche outcomes.

allowed: axis-agnostic inferential machinery over finite discrete support tensors
representation invariance under positive scaling, axis permutation, state relabelling and omitted nuisance refinement
exact same-distribution identity between transferability gain and mutual information
heterogeneous empirical portability across three prospectively bounded architectures
forbidden: all ecological niches are multidimensionally thick
temporal dimensions are intrinsically more generalizable than vertical dimensions
discretization is universally optimal for continuous ecological variables
information-theoretic metrics remove detectability or observation bias
the framework identifies causal competition or habitat preference
three empirical lanes prove universal biological generality
